reason: Fixed finite-prime avoidance and positive density retain their prime set before n tends to infinity; they give no uniform all-prime control. The positive logarithmic-density set U avoids only universal leading digits p-1, and is strictly larger than the desired coprime set (n33 survives U but q33=11 via another harmonic zero digit). The remaining union of non-universal zero-digit obstructions over growing primes is unboundedly uncontrolled. No coprime infinitude proof/refutation is claimed; prior noncoprime infinitude and pairwise log independence do not settle it.
